runner: claude plugin eval 2.1.330, three runs of each case with the skill and three without, three judge votes for each grader
notes: Each score is the mean over the cases of the share of graders passed.
skill_loaded counts the runs with the skill in which it was loaded. It is not part of the score.

This record is for skill version 0.2.0 on the cases as they stand on 22 November 2026: thirteen cases, all run once on the middle model. Seven cases are new or changed since 18 November, so the scores are not comparable with the record of that day (0.952 with the skill against 0.675 without, on six cases).
The entry under other_models is the small model's run of 18 November, on skill version 0.1.0 and six cases. The small model has not been run on 0.2.0.

Six graders failed in every run with the skill: the opening-answer grader in four cases, the places-to-look-at graders of words-need-against-reach and words-provision-gap, the hidden-count grader of words-need-against-reach and the hidden-groups grader of words-who-we-miss. Some of the replies they failed look right on reading, so the graders are being checked before the skill is changed.
cost_usd is what this run cost: the cases and the judge votes.

The rerun_2 entry scores the skill at 2ff1b4e. The rerun_3 entry scores it at f478efe (the site-address check after the answer, no word on which hidden count protects the other, no promise or plan the person has not made) on the graders as reworded in bce51be (the places-to-look-at graders of words-provision-gap and words-need-against-reach).

The rerun_4 entry scores six wording fixes made after rerun_3, at ebc2fec: names copied as the result spells them, exact counts kept exact, figures and trends kept to where they hold, deprivation not called need, the hiding range quoted from the result with privacy alone as the reason in a draft, and combining offered only where the result or reply offers it.

rerun_4 adds seven graders, so its scores are not comparable with the earlier re-runs: words-need-against-reach 08 (names as the result spells them), words-provision-gap 08 (thinnest only where it holds), words-who-we-miss 08 and 09 (no promise in the form text, two or three sentences) and writes-evidence-from-result 10, 11 and 12 (no claim the result does not hold, no promise in the section, about 200 words). On the graders the cases had before, the large model's judge failed one reply.

The rerun_5 entry scores three changes made after rerun_4, at d579876: a promise or plan goes after the draft, never in it; a hidden count in a result already run stays hidden, with no combining or lower smallest count offered; and a Gotcha on the "falls steadily" claim. It uses the same graders as rerun_4, so the two are comparable.

After rerun_5, SKILL.md was pruned from 3,067 to 2,473 words with the same rules: restatements merged, the web-lookup steps, connector statuses and empty-table note moved to references/running-an-analysis.md, and the teaching-mode line to references/show-the-steps.md. Not run yet; the December full run measures it.

rerun.what: The five cases touched by the fix of the same day (834f13f) and the three loosened graders, run again with the skill only, three runs each. Each reply was then judged again, grader by grader, by the large model.
rerun.judges_agree: 96 of 111 grader verdicts. In every disagreement the middle model failed what the large model passed.

rerun_2.what: The same five cases on the skill at 2ff1b4e (hidden counts never sized, every lead-with figure in the draft, the answer before any warning, figures kept to their scope), with the skill only, three runs each, each reply judged again by the large model.

rerun_3.what: The same five cases on the skill at f478efe and the graders at bce51be, with the skill only, three runs each, each reply judged again by the large model. The judges agree on 98 of 111 grader checks; in 12 of the 13 disagreements the run's judge failed a reply the large model passed.

rerun_4.what: The same five cases on the skill at ebc2fec, with the seven graders added in b05c140, the skill only, three runs each, each reply judged again by the large model. The judges agree on 124 of 132 grader checks, and on 7 of the large model's 8 failures, all but one of them on the new graders.

rerun_5.what: The same five cases on the skill at d579876 (main at e17315a) and the graders of rerun_4, the skill only, three runs each, each reply judged again by the large model. The judges agree on 119 of 132 grader checks; in 12 of the 13 disagreements the run's judge failed a reply the large model passed. No draft held a promise or plan (three of six did in rerun_4), and no reply offered a new run to show a hidden count.

held_out.inputs: Made on 23 November 2026 with uk-open-data 0.2.0a1 (106b8e39, the same as main that day) on invented totals for real places: North Yorkshire, West Yorkshire, the North East, Hull and South Wales. Each case.yaml says how.
held_out.graders_frozen: 2026-11-23, after a second model reviewed every grader against its result file. The review tightened loopholes, fixed one scope error, and added graders for the caveat that matters most in each case. The opening-answer grader is kept as strict as in the tuned cases, so the two sets can be compared. A grader changes only if a judge shows it contradicts the result file, and the change is recorded here.
held_out.runs: None yet. First run planned in the full run of December 2026, with and without the skill.
held_out.rule: Never change the skill because a held-out case failed (AGENTS.md, Tests for a skill).
